headline: Florida bear hunting permit applications open Sept. 11 for 2026 season
teaser: Applications for Florida's 2026 regulated bear hunting season will open Sept. 11, with permits distributed through a random drawing for hunts scheduled Dec. 5-27.
body:
Florida hunters will be able to begin applying Sept. 11 for permits to participate in the state's 2026 regulated bear hunting season.

Bear harvest permit applications will open at 10 a.m. EDT on Friday, Sept. 11, and remain available through 11:59 p.m. on Sept. 21. A bear harvest permit will be required to harvest a bear in one of the four selected Bear Harvest Zones during the season, which runs from Dec. 5 through Dec. 27.

Hunters also must have a valid hunting license unless they qualify for an exemption.

## How the permit drawing works

Applicants must be at least 18 years old by Oct. 1. Hunters may submit as many applications as they choose during the application period, with each application costing $5 plus applicable handling fees.

Permits will be awarded through a random drawing. Each person can receive no more than one permit, and permits cannot be transferred to another hunter.

For applicants selected in the drawing, bear harvest permits will cost $100 for Florida residents and $300 for nonresidents, plus handling fees. No more than 10% of the total permits issued will go to nonresidents.

## How to apply

Hunters can apply online through [GoOutdoorsFlorida.com](https://gooutdoorsflorida.com/) by signing into their account and selecting “Apply for Limited Entry/Quota Permits.”

Applications also can be completed using an application worksheet and submitted through a license agent or Florida tax collector's office.

Hunters who need help with the application process can find [information about limited-entry and quota permits on the Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission website](https://myfwc.com/license/limited-entry/).

Additional information about the season, permits and Florida bear hunting is available on the FWC's [Florida bear hunting page](https://myfwc.com/bearhunting/).
